requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve the original finding wording, criterion, objective evidence, source classification, assigned grade and due-date provenance while separating internal interpretation
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow fixes the source finding record with original text, criteria, objective evidence, source, assigned classification and due-date provenance and separates facts, internal interpretation and unknowns.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: route investigation, CAPA, risk and other systemic work to existing specialist owners and track their evidence without creating a parallel finding-CAPA process
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly routes causal investigation, CAPA, risk, supplier, validation, change, record and regulatory work to existing specialist owners and only tracks references/status.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: rewrite the external finding or grade to make the response easier to defend
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Preserve-the-source-finding and source-severity principles require the external wording and classification to remain unchanged and referencable.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: claim external closure merely because a response or CAPA plan was prepared or submitted
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill states that response submitted is not finding closed and requires verified external closure evidence.
